verdict.rationale: Pendo is a product-analytics platform, so letting users opt out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair axis. However, the evidence pack documents no opt-out control. Session-replay masking and the visitor-deletion API are adjacent privacy features: masking limits what is captured, and deletion removes data after the fact. Neither lets a user opt out of tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
